thread:
Maya Chen: Quick status check — cutline opens in ~30m. We have 3 cherry PRs queued. PR #4821 is blocked by a flaky e2e: failure in `tests/serving/inference_perf.py` (timeout). Can we get an owner? @Alejandro?
Alejandro Ruiz: On it. I see a JVM OOM in runner-2 when running the perf suite. Trying to repro locally with `pytest tests/serving -k inference_perf -q` now.
CI-Bot: Re-run started for PR #4821 by @Alejandro. Jobs queued: linux-gpu, linux-x86. Estimated duration ~12m.
Samir Patel: FYI PR #4877 (rollback for quant tweak) is green but needs a release note. @Jess can you add a one-liner? Also it shows ~+3% token latency in canary — tagging to decide acceptability.
Jess Kim: Adding release note now. For perf: policy is block if p95 regresses >2% across canary. Can someone paste canary numbers?
Priya Nair: Also seeing `dedicated-autoscaler` spike causing pod restarts in staging after #4877 landed to canary. Filing issue #1092 and attaching logs.
Alejandro Ruiz: CI flakes reproduced locally; test seed `--seed=1842` triggers a race in the setup. Quick fix: bump the wait in the test from 500ms -> 2s. I'll push a tiny test patch to #4821.
Maya Chen: If that fix won't land before cut, we should defer #4821 to the next train. We don't want a last-minute rollback mid-cut. Can someone confirm hotfixability later?
Samir Patel: I agree defer unless it merges cleanly. For #4877, if canary stays at +3% we should consider rolling back the RT tweak and revisit quant params.
Jess Kim: Release note added to #4877. I also queued `canary-regen` so we can get a fresh perf run. @CI-Bot please kick it off.
CI-Bot: canary-regen job started by @Jess. Will post results in ~10m.
ReleaseBot: Cutline window opens in 28m. Current blockers: PR #4821 (test flake), canary perf +3% from #4877, autoscaler restarts in staging. Need owners for autoscaler issue.
Priya Nair: Taking autoscaler. I'll open a patch to adjust pod liveness and memory margins. ETA ~2h but I'll try a quick mitigation (increase pod memory) pre-cut.
Maya Chen: Thanks Priya. If mitigation is >15m we'll proceed with the cut and exclude the offending PRs from this train. Please ping when mitigation is applied.
Alejandro Ruiz: Pushed hotfix to #4821 (test wait bump). CI re-run succeeded locally; upstream is queued. Requesting quick review from @Samir.
Samir Patel: LGTM. Will merge after CI green. If it passes fast we can include #4821; otherwise defer to next train.
CI-Bot: PR #4821 CI passed. Merge scheduled. Merged by @Samir at 3923462000.
Maya Chen: Nice — that unblocks one item. Any final objections to proceeding with the train cut in ~22m? @release-coordinator
release-coordinator: No objections. Proceed with cut. I'll mark excluded PRs if any new blockers pop up. Good luck :rocket:
